description: SMT Contract & Policy Logic Prover — Answers a yes/no logic question about contract clauses, IAM/OPA policies or business rules with a solver-backed result and a plain-language headline and next step. Takes clauses or pasted text (or a formal IR directly with zero LLM calls), formalizes them into typed Boolean, integer and rational constraints, then answers "is P possible", "does invariant I always hold" or "are any clauses contradic

maxConflicts.description: Lower this step budget (default and hard cap 300000).

maxMillis.description: Lower this step budget (default and hard cap 25000).

maxPivots.description: Lower this step budget (default and hard cap 2000000).

maxPropagations.description: Lower this step budget (default and hard cap 60000000).

maxSolves.description: Lower this step budget (default and hard cap 2000).

maxSplits.description: Lower this step budget (default and hard cap 5000).

maxWork.description: Lower this step budget (default and hard cap 40000000).

clauses.description: Natural-language contract clauses, IAM/OPA policy statements or business rules, each with a caller-chosen id. Mutually exclusive with ir.

ir.description: Formal IR, solved with zero LLM calls: {variables:[{name,type:bool|int|real,min?,max?}], constraints:[{id,expr,source?}], query:{mode:possible|always|consistency,formula?,source?}}. Expressions are JSON ASTs: {op:"var",name}, {op:"num",value:"3/4"}, {op:"true"|"false"}, and {op,args} for not, and, or, implies, iff, ite, =, !=, <, <=, >, >=, add, sub, neg, mul (one side constant). Numbers are exact strings.

query.description: The question, e.g. "Can an unauthorized user ever approve a payout over $10,000?" or "Are any clauses mutually contradictory?". Required with clauses.

text.description: Alternative to clauses: the contract, policy or rules pasted as plain text. It is split into clauses by blank lines and numbered or bulleted lines (ids C1.2 or S3). Use clauses when you need your own ids. Requires query.

name: smt-contract-prover
